_read_me: Settings for tools/mfp_nightly.py. Copy with 'py tools/mfp_nightly.py init' (it goes to %LOCALAPPDATA%\RiteBite\MFP Nightly\config.json, outside the repository) and fill in every FILL IN. The mfp section comes from 'MFP technical notes.txt'; 'py tools/mfp_nightly.py probe' shows what MFP actually sends so you can check it. No password goes in this file. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
mfp_username: FILL IN: the MFP login used for the nightly run

sharepoint.client_id: FILL IN: Application (client) ID of the nightly app registration

mfp._dates_without_offset_are: How MFP's times with no time zone should be read: UTC, or America/Chicago. Check against a delivery date you know.

login.page_path: FILL IN: path of the login page, e.g. /Account/Login
login.post_path: FILL IN: path the login form posts to
login.username_field: FILL IN: name of the username/email input
login.password_field: FILL IN: name of the password input
login._token_field: Hidden anti-forgery field on the login form, if any (ASP.NET sites usually have __RequestVerificationToken). Leave empty if none.

mfp._grids: Placeholders in params: {page} (1, 2, ...), {page_index} (0, 1, ...), {page_size}, {skip}, {date_from}, {date_to} (written with date_format). send_as: query (in the address, GET), form or json (POST body). Field names may use dots for nested values, e.g. Group.Id. An empty field name means MFP doesn't have it.

fundraisers.send_as: FILL IN: query, form or json
fundraisers.params: FILL IN: replace this text with an object of the paging, all-owners, all-statuses and delivery-date filter parameters from the notes, e.g. {"page": "{page}", "pageSize": "{page_size}"}

fields.owning_user: FILL IN: owning user code (BPR, KJS, ...)

invoices.send_as: FILL IN: query, form or json
invoices.params: FILL IN: same idea as the fundraisers list

fields.owning_user: FILL IN: invoice owning user code

fields.owner: FILL IN: the group's current owning user code
